title: Alaska got written into America's AI moonshot and nobody noticed
lines: Last Wednesday, the U S Energy Department published two hundred science projects.
It's the Genesis Mission, America's bet on A I for hard science.
Alaska's line reads Aurora A I. Real time A I for the power grid, run by the University of Alaska Fairbanks.
That's the whole public record. No abstract, no budget, and nobody here has reported it.
But you can see why they picked the grid.
Alaska isn't one grid. It's hundreds of separate ones.
Cordova powers itself. Twenty six hundred people, their own hydro dam.
That same department already spent six point two million there,
building a live computer model of that grid, updating in real time.
So Alaska isn't a footnote. It's the test bed.
One line of public record. What's in it?
